* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CRASH.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Badlands|Badlands]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Catalina.png]]The Welcome Pump, Dillimore, Red County

After the cutscene, you discover that the mystery cousin of Cesar is none other than Catalina from GTA3.

This mission is a bit odd, in that upon triggering it, you must complete one of the four robbery missions, which are:

* [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Bank.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Tanker Commander|Tanker Commander]]
* [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Bank.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Against All Odds|Against All Odds]]
* [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Bank.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Local Liquor Store|Local Liquor Store]]
* [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Bank.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Small Town Bank|Small Town Bank]]

If the subsequent robbery mission is completed, then this mission is also considered complete, and the new missions for this mission become available.

== Rewards ==
''None''
